scope: Offline full-body candidate search and model ablation; no new native success

load_audit.scope: Replay a failed candidate and measure its model support impulses, not native forces.
load_audit.limitation: Model impulse-derived mean forces do not establish real foot/head loading or prove infeasibility.

arm_ablation.scope: Same-state same-leg-trajectory arm ablation; model execution only.
arm_ablation.limitation: Conditional comparison at one selected trajectory; not a controlled comparison of search algorithms or native success rates.
